# checks every location in the default.map list of volcano locations monthly
volcano_location_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
	}

	random_events = {
		#earthquake events
		40 = volcano_events.1 #weak eruption somewhat frequent
		30 = volcano_events.2 #minor eruption somewhat frequent
		20 = volcano_events.3 #major eruption less frequent
		10 = volcano_events.4 #catastrophic eruption rare

		chance_to_happen = 0.02 #Around one eruption per volcano per 500 years
	}

}


#checks one random location each month.. yay.
earthquake_location_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
	}

	random_events = {
		#earthquake events
		16 = earthquake_events.90 #minor earthquake somewhat frequent
		4 = earthquake_events.91 #major earthquake less frequent
		1 = earthquake_events.92 #catastrophic earthquake rare

		chance_to_happen = 2
	}
}
